reasoning: This repository is a container image build configuration project. It defines Dockerfiles, build arguments, manifests, and Makefile targets for building Jupyter workbenches, Code-Server workbenches, runtime images, and base images for the OpenDataHub/RHOAI ecosystem. It does not contain an operator controller, a Go/Python service, or a reusable library. Its primary output is container images published to quay.io, configured via multi-stage Dockerfiles, versions_config.yml, and Kustomize manifests under manifests/. The PRODUCT variable selects between ODH (CentOS Stream 9) and RHOAI (RHEL 9.8 EUS) build variants. Classification: configuration — it configures and orchestrates the build of container images rather than implementing application logic.
